title: env-misconfig flags test-infra env keys as missing deploy requirements
symptom: env-misconfig flags test-infrastructure env keys (playwright configs, e2e harnesses, capture scripts) as missing from .env.example. The rule's remediation — 'a fresh deploy fails' — does not apply to test-only keys that already carry ?? defaults.
expected: Test tooling (playwright/vite configs, e2e/) and scripts/tools/ dirs are skipped; product-code keys still flag.
regression_test: vitest: scanner/src/rules.test.ts (clean-app zero-findings gate + FP-class coverage checks)
root_cause: checkRepo walked every source file without distinguishing product code from test/tooling paths.
bench_note: Scope fix in checkRepo plus test-tooling classification; same regression gate.
notes: Same discovery pass as deploy-misconfig-env-backed-fp. Genuine product-code keys (e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) must still be flagged.
